issue_context.title: ActiveSupport::Cache#fetch_multi does not respect the force option
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce

Create a brand new rails app, `rails dev:cache` to enable caching in dev mode, then open up a console via `rails console` and paste the following:

```ruby
Rails.cache
Rails.cache.fetch_multi("foo", "bar") { |key| "original value for #{key}" }
Rails.cache.read("foo") # => "original value for foo"
Rails.cache.fetch_multi("foo", "bar", force: true) { |key| "forced value for #{key}" }
Rails.cache.read("foo") # => "original value for foo"
```

Note that this behavior is the same across all cache store implementations - we originally witnessed this in our production Rails app that uses the Redis cache store. It appears the force option was just never implemented for [fetch_multi](https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/274f8543e6e941ceba1d099e8f2081ea8fb8ca29/activesupport/lib/active_support/cache.rb#L453-L473).

### Expected behavior

The forced values should be set, and the second cache read should return `forced value for foo`

### Actual behavior

The forced values are never set, and the original values are returned:

```
=> ActiveSupport::Cache::MemoryStore entries=2, size=530, options={:compress=>false}>
=> {"foo"=>"original value for foo", "bar"=>"original value for bar"}
=> "original value for foo"
=> {"foo"=>"original value for foo", "bar"=>"original value for bar"}
=> "original value for foo"
```

### System configuration
**Rails version**:  6.1.3, but also seen in our production app running 5.2

**Ruby version**: 2.6.5
comments:
Note that we have worked around this in our app with an extension on ActiveSupport::Cache::Store that works fine:

```ruby
module FetchMultiFix
  def fetch_multi(*names)
    options = names.extract_options!
    if options[:force]
      hash = names.each_with_object({}) { |name, hsh|
        hsh[name] = yield(name)
      }
      write_multi(hash)
      hash
    else
      super
    end
  end
end

ActiveSupport::Cache::Store.prepend(FetchMultiFix)
```
The PR has been updated to pass Rubocop, could this get some eyes on it and perhaps a merge?
